ctaHeading: Ready for a Tarneit Outdoor Makeover?
aboutText: Royal Landscaping and Decking Melbourne is your one-stop solution for all landscaping and outdoor services in Tarneit. With several years of experience, we have earned hundreds of satisfied customer reviews. Specialising in pergolas, patios, fencing, decking, and more, we deliver quality work tailored to your needs. From landscape design to concrete works, we handle it all with expertise.
servicesText: From landscape design to fencing and decking, we offer a wide range of services to transform your outdoor space. Our team specialises in quality workmanship for patios, pergolas, concrete works, and turf installation across Tarneit and Melbourne's west.

services.title: Landscape Design
services.desc: Custom designs to enhance your outdoor living areas with creative and functional layouts.

services.title: Fencing and Retaining Walls
services.desc: Installation of timber and Colorbond fences plus sturdy retaining walls for security and aesthetics.

services.title: Decking and Timber Works
services.desc: High-quality timber and composite decking solutions for durable and stylish outdoor spaces.

services.title: Concrete Works
services.desc: Driveways, aprons, and concrete floors finished to perfection for lasting appeal.

services.title: Patio, Pergola & Tiling
services.desc: Constructing beautiful patios, pergolas, and tiling for comfortable outdoor entertaining areas.

services.title: Turf and Garden Services
services.desc: Supply and installation of artificial and natural grass to keep your garden lush.
